name: Nedbank
verdict: The Nedbank brand on the Sables' shirt is Nedbank Zimbabwe, the Zimbabwean bank of JSE-listed Nedbank Group, in which Old Mutual holds a 19.9% minority stake. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of the Zimbabwe Sables, worn at the World Rugby Nations Cup 2026 (official ZRU match-day graphic, 1 July 2026). Nedbank's brand name also titles the Nedbank Golf Challenge (event name, 2026 Race to Dubai schedule). Old Mutual's 19.9% stake is as stated for the 2018 unbundling; its current size was not separately sourced. No human-rights record of the kind METHOD.md counts was found for Nedbank Zimbabwe, Nedbank Group or Old Mutual.
